$comment: ZH-001 — City of Zürich BZO 'Table-2' FORMULA rules (the executable setback / distance machinery that
the per-zone ch-zh-zurich-BZO-zones.json cannot express as a scalar). These are the founder-cited Art.38
rules + the PBG §260 definitions. RECONCILED from the founder's cited rule statements; NO per-zone
numeric Grundabstand table is invented here (that table is UNKNOWN — see zones JSON setbackTableStatus).
Each rule carries the caps/inputs the founder stated. Where a value is zone-dependent and not yet
extracted (the Mehrlängenzuschlag cap), it is null with a typed reason — never guessed. confidence is

rules.name: Mehrlängenzuschlag (façade-length setback surcharge)

facadeLength.description: length of the façade facing the boundary (projected)

capZoneDependent.reason: the per-zone cap on the surcharge is not yet extracted from the scanned BZO/Art.38 ordinance — human-gated; do not guess

output.name: grenzabstandZuschlag_m
output.appliesTo: side (Grenzabstand) — additive to the base Grundabstand

rules.note: The base per-zone Grundabstand this surcharge adds to is the UNKNOWN Art.38 kleiner/grosser table; the cap is likewise unextracted. Formula shape (len-12)/3 is founder-cited.

structure.description: an ancillary/small building (Kleinbaute) as classified by the BZO

rules.name: Underground structure minimum boundary distance (no Baulinie)

parcel.hasBaulinie: boolean — whether a building line (Baulinie) governs the frontage

output.name: minBoundaryDistance_m
output.appliesTo: boundary distance for underground structures where no Baulinie applies

rules.note: Where a Baulinie DOES apply, the Baulinie geometry governs the frontage instead (see zones JSON setbacks.front, resolver 'geometry').

rules.name: Gebäudeabstand / Grenzabstand definition (measurement rule)

facade.description: the projected façade plane of the building

reference.description: the parcel boundary (Grenzabstand) or the opposing building's façade (Gebäudeabstand)

rules.formula: Grenzabstand = perpendicular distance from projected-façade plane to the parcel boundary; Gebäudeabstand = perpendicular distance from projected-façade plane to the opposing building's projected-façade plane

output.name: measurementDefinition
output.appliesTo: how all Grundabstand / Gebäudeabstand values in the zone table are measured

rules.note: PBG is the cantonal (Kanton Zürich) parent law; BZO Art.38 supplies the municipal numeric setbacks, PBG §260 supplies the measurement definition. Hierarchy: see ch-zh-zurich-LEGAL-HIERARCHY.md.
